title: Jojoba cleansing balm
subtitle: An oil-based face cleanser that removes makeup and sunscreen
excerpt: Cleansing balm is a solid face cleanser made from jojoba oil, shea butter, and emulsifying wax: it melts on the face with fingertip warmth and emulsifies fully when rinsed with water, carrying makeup, sunscreen, and daily grime away without stripping. Makes 100 g in a small pot; keeps six months at room temperature.
sourceNotes: Oil cleansing as a face-cleansing method: The Double Cleanse by Caroline Hirons (2022). Emulsifying wax NF (INCI: Cetearyl Alcohol and Polysorbate 60) as a balm-to-milk emulsifier: Cosmetic Ingredient Review assessment (2014). Jojoba as a main cleansing carrier: its liquid wax ester composition dissolves sebum and cosmetic products similarly to the skin's own oils. Shea butter at 20% for texture and creaminess.

recipe.yieldDescription: ~100 g in a small jar or pot
recipe.batchNotes: Double the recipe and fill two small pots.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Allow to cool and set fully at room temperature before sealing. The texture firms further over 24 hours as the wax matrix stabilises.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: Six months at room temperature. Keep the pot dry, water in the emulsifying wax can cause separation and mould growth. Discard if the balm develops an off smell or visible growth.

glossaryTerms.definition: A cosmetic wax that acts as an emulsifier, it allows oil and water to mix temporarily. In a cleansing balm, emulsifying wax causes the solid product to turn milky and rinse cleanly when water touches it, taking dissolved makeup and oils with it.

content.text: Melt the emulsifying wax and beeswax together in a heatproof bowl over a pan of simmering water. Add the shea butter and stir until fully melted. Remove from heat. Add the jojoba oil and stir until smooth. Cool to 45°C, then pour into a small jar or pot. Leave undisturbed at room temperature until fully set, about one hour. The balm firms further over 24 hours.

Scoop a small amount, about a pea-sized portion, onto dry fingertips and massage over a dry face for 30 to 60 seconds. The balm will soften and dissolve as you work it in. Add a small amount of water to emulsify the balm, it will turn white and milky. Rinse thoroughly with warm water and follow with a water-based cleanser if wearing heavy makeup or sunscreen (the classic two-step cleanse).

Six months at room temperature in a sealed pot. Use a dry spatula or scoop, water in the pot compromises the balm's stability. Discard if the texture separates and will not re-blend, or if the balm develops an off smell.
